main_bar.count is the two-way total of the printed mat (5+5 / 6+6). The edge tie is printed 'RB 9 รัดรอบ' with no count or spacing — recorded as count 1 per section 6b (a single tie round the footing edge), no spacing invented.
Below the footing each section prints 0.05 + 0.05 with the labels คอนกรีตหยาบ 1:3:5 and ทรายหยาบอัดแน่น — read as 0.05 lean concrete over 0.05 compacted sand.
The column stub inside the footing is drawn with a C1 tag in plan; its own section (C1 0.15 x 0.15, 4-DB12) is on S-06.
